messages:
Elaine H: Quick async standup — heads up: renewal at risk for Kestrel Health. Summary: webhook retries spiked overnight, customers seeing 504s from our ingest endpoint. Escalation opened with CS-ES team.

Elaine H: What I did: triaged logs, opened a support ticket with Kestrel, flagged on-prem routing oddities.

Elaine H: Blockers: need eng help to confirm whether the recent routing change (region failover) caused KV cache miss storm. Also need a short rollback plan if we can't stabilize in 2h.

Mike S: Thanks Elaine. I pinged the customer success manager, they said renewal call is EOD tomorrow — we need to show progress. I told them we're on it. :white_check_mark:

Noor A: Can you paste the main error pattern? Are the 504s from the gateway or our proxied upstream?

Elaine H: Logs show gateway upstream timeouts to ingest cluster. Sample repeated pattern: `upstream_timeout: POST /v1/webhook 504 host=ingest-redwood-eu-2`

Elaine H: Also saw increased `kv_cache_miss` for model routing keys during the same window.

Sam P: I'm on it — pulling traces now. Can someone @eng-infra and @eng-runtime for kernel/route changes?

Sam P: Quick ping to eng-oncall: @Sam P (eng-oncall) — I will look at routing config and recent ramp on eu-2.

deploy-bot: deploy 2456ed triggered by ci/cd at 2456788000 — started rollout to eu region.

Sam P: That deploy included the new routing policy that prefers eu-2 for low-latency customers. I'll do an impact check on prefix caching logic.

Sam P: Short snippet I'm testing locally to reproduce (log filter):
```
cat logs | jq 'select(.upstream=="ingest-eu-2") | {ts, request_id, upstream_status, kv_cache_hit}'
```

Noor A: If KV cache misses line up with the deploy timestamp, we can correlate. Can you post the deploy id?

Sam P: Deploy id 2456ed (from deploy-bot above). Timeline matches. I have a quick mitigation: lower preference weight for eu-2 routing and re-enable previous cache priming. Will put up a PR in ~15m.

Elaine H: Please include a short rollback script in the PR description — customer team will ask for one if we touch prod during the window.

Sam P: Yep — adding `scripts/rollback-routing.sh` and tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/6129 (draft)

Mike S: Great — once Sam posts the PR, I'll message the CSM and give them the ETA. Also prepping a short customer note for the EOD renewal call.

Sam P: Update: rolled back weight to previous values in canary, latency improved, 504s down in canary. Kestrel reported fewer retries after canary change. Propagating to remainder of region now.

Noor A: Nice. Can we add a short alert rule to detect rapid kv_cache_miss increases next 24h?

Sam P: On it — adding a temporary alert: `kv_cache_miss_rate > 5% for 5m` to the cs-runbook channel.

Elaine H: Thank you team. Blocker cleared for now. I'll update the renewal thread and call notes.

Mike S: I'll join the EOD sync and share the mitigation steps. Thanks everyone. :pray:

Sam P: Leaving a postmortem draft in #incidents — will add timeline and commit ids.

Elaine H: If anything regresses ping me directly. Otherwise closing this async check-in.
